correctness.rationale: Fix the k cycle vertices and cyclic order. Removing its cycle edges leaves a uniformly distributed forest with k specified roots and F(n,k)=k*n**(n-k-1) for n>k (1 for n=k). For r labeled J-leaves and s labeled H-leaves, deleting the leaves and reattaching gives k**r (m-r-s)**s F(n-r-s,k) completions per ordered distinct marked tuple; summation produces all (m)_(r+s) factorial moments. The r,s=(1,0),(0,1),(1,1) cases give the displayed covariance. For m>=3, the exact E[JH]/(E[J]E[H]) equals (m-2)/m*(n/(n-1))**2*(1-1/(n-1)**2)**(m-3)<1 because m<=n-3 and m(n-1)**2-(m-2)n**2=2n(n-m)+m>0. At m=2, E[JH]=0; m<=1 gives zero covariance. Expansion for k/n->alpha in (0,1) gives -alpha*(1-alpha)**2*(1+alpha**2)*exp(-2(1-alpha)). Independent exact rooted-forest enumeration through n=7 checked 65 mixed moments across 1425 forests. This is analytic for every admissible n,k; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The conditional two-type leaf statistic is a natural local/global interface statistic of the unicyclic graph model; the exact finite joint law and universally negative covariance (with explicit linear-order limit) are complete distributional information absent from an uncolored total-leaf count. This is a motivated structural dependency result rather than an arbitrary graph instance.

final_claim: The full mixed factorial-moment law for cycle-adjacent (J) and farther (H) pendant leaves, strict negative covariance at n-k>=2, and its linear-scale alpha limit, for uniform simple labeled connected unicyclic graphs conditional on cycle length k.
